overview: We build your Wix app with the Wix CLI so it installs cleanly on Wix sites and stores. After agreeing the idea and screens, we create the dashboard page where site owners manage settings, a site widget that appears on their pages and the backend that stores their data. You get the code in your repository, a test site and a checklist for submitting to the Wix App Market.

faq: Do I need a Wix developer account?
Yes, it is free. You create the account in the Wix Dev Center and add us as a collaborator. We build the app there and never ask for your passwords.
Will the app work on any Wix site?
It works on sites that meet the app's requirements, which we set with you. Some features depend on the site having a Premium plan or a Wix business solution such as Stores or Bookings.
Will Wix approve my app for the App Market?
Wix reviews every public app and we cannot promise approval. We build to their published requirements, run the checklist before you submit and fix review feedback within your package.
You do. The code goes into your own repository from the start, with setup notes. Any developer can maintain it later, and there are no licence fees to us.
